seo.title: About us
seo.description: Meet the neighbourhood sourdough bakery and cafe on Mill Lane, Leeds, baking for local families and office workers.

sections.title: A bakery for the neighbourhood.
sections.lede: We bake sourdough, pastries and cakes for the people who live and work around Mill Lane.

sections.title: Our story
sections.body:
## Why we bake

We believe good bread should be part of everyday life, not a special treat. That is why we bake sourdough the patient way and serve it right here in our Leeds neighbourhood.

## Who we bake for

Our doors open early for office workers who want a proper breakfast on the way in, and our weekends are made for families who want to linger over brunch. Whether you come in for a single loaf or a celebration cake, you get the same care.

## What you will find

- Sourdough loaves baked fresh
- Pastries that follow the seasons
- A relaxed weekend brunch
- Celebration cakes made to order

sections.title: Cakes for the moments that matter.
body: Birthdays, anniversaries, office farewells: a good cake brings people together. We make every celebration cake to order, around your occasion and your taste.
Book a call and we will plan it with you, step by step.
